name: CoA Legendary Items: SQL spells and ability selectors in the client stream
contract: Requires CoALegendaryItems.Enable=1 and CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1. All 64 SQL-only power spells are streamed using the 170-word SMSG_PATCH_SPELL layout and four sized strings. Timed buffs have native eight-second duration, visible attributes, an existing icon and amount-aware descriptions. Signature modifiers and every first/highest native ability rank carry matching dedicated selectors. Captured socketless packets establish construction, not client rendering or delivery.
